name: LinPrim Gradient Computation
definition: Computes gradients of intersection depths $\mathbf{i}$ with respect to ray space triangle corners $\mathbf{v}^{\text{ray}}$ to enable differentiable rendering of linear primitives.
summary: LinPrim Gradient Computation enables differentiable rendering by backpropagating gradients through a linear primitive rasterizer, differing from Gaussian Splatting by using intersection depth-based opacity.
